operation: Y = X W^T; X:[U,K], W:[N,K], Y:[U,N]
counted_input: each X[b,k] once at the operator entrance; no receiver fan-out multiplier
limit_interpretation: U->infinity is the asymptotic one-load reuse limit: Q_S and RI diverge while Q_R remains N*K*b_w. It is not a finite batch or a record with zero in-window writes.
source: 2026-10-02 用户要求统一为复用次数 U，II(a) 七档扫描、中文正文与小数 RI
U_definition: actual input vectors served by one complete logical weight load; equals the GEMM row dimension, not necessarily a global batch size

display.RI: RI >= 1: one decimal place; 0 < RI < 1: three significant digits, fixed decimal notation; ROUND_HALF_UP
